scope_statement: RECONNAISSANCE ONLY. No corpus was bulk-downloaded. Neo4j was not touched. Network activity was limited to catalogue and metadata reads, MediaWiki and GitHub API listings, HEAD liveness probes, and a small number of single-file probe fetches (each named in verification_log) taken solely to confirm that a file's format is what this map claims it is. No authentication, paywall, DRM, CAPTCHA, private API or login-only archive was bypassed; two hosts that returned HTTP 403 to automated requests were recorded as unverified rather than worked around.
reading_rules: coverage_verification is the load-bearing field. If it says UNVERIFIED, the coverage claim beside it is a lead, not a fact, and Wave 1 must not plan capacity against it.

tradition_recension plus recension_evidence must be read together. A recension named without evidence is a guess. Where the evidence is circumstantial the record says so and names the check that would settle it.

quality_class describes the ARTIFACT, not the tradition behind it. A traditional index carried by an unsourced community transcription has the tradition's authority and the transcriber's accuracy, and those are different things.

A CC0 or Public Domain Mark applied by a re-uploader is evidence of nothing. This project has already been burned by that once (atharvaveda_202107 vs atharvaveda_202106, byte-identical files with opposite licence tags).
Several records are DEAD ENDS or NAMED TRAPS and are kept deliberately. A catalogue that only lists what worked makes the next agent repeat the failures.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: The AV translation gap is a single object, not a distribution.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: 958 of the 961 missing AV translations are kanda 20, and the remaining three are AVS 3.9.4, 5.12.11 and 10.8.30. Kanda 20 is absent from BOTH incumbent AV sources for the same reason: Whitney excluded it as 'in the main a pure mass of excerpts from the Rigveda', and DCS's AVS directory likewise stops at kanda 19.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: One acquisition (Griffith's AV, books 8-20) closes 99.7% of the gap.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Non-RV Devata is largely NOT a sourcing problem.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: The AV devata source - Whitney's Brhatsarvanukramani brackets - is already pinned locally as 1,254 gapless Page:-namespace snapshots with a 55 KB builder written, and its chandas half is already ingested (4,082 of 5,839). The YV devata source - Katyayana's Sarvanukramana-sutra - is also already snapshotted locally and was deliberately not machine-resolved because it is continuous sutra prose using lingokta. Only the SV had no located source at all, and now it does.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Wave 1 should treat AV devata as an ingestion and scope-modelling task, YV devata as a philology task, and SV devata as the only real acquisition.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Roughly half the AV and YV audio gap may be a mapping defect, not absence.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: The discovery report records 495 AV and 33 YV verses as text_mismatch - the source HAS audio at that coordinate but the recited text did not match ours. That is the signature of a numbering divergence, and the module already corrects exactly such a divergence for Mandala 8's Valakhilya permutation, where a naive mapping would have misattached 55 hymns.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Diagnose before acquiring. A hymn-division offset is cheaper to fix than a recording is to find.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: The Samaveda's attribution and notation live on the GANA pages, not the ARCIKA pages.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Sampling proved it: 16 arcika pages on Sanskrit Wikisource carry 184 verse markers and ZERO rishi/chandas/devata triads, while gana pages carry the triads, the Unicode notation, the Commons audio, the performance metadata, the running arcika number and the Rigveda cross-reference. The Arseya Brahmana - the Kauthuma rishi index - is likewise organised by Gramageya and Aranyaka, i.e. by saman.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Every SV attribution claim will be at SAMAN scope and will reach a verse only through the source-stated yoni-verse running number. That is a modelling decision to make once, deliberately, before any ingest.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: The Samaveda is absent from every morphological resource that exists.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: DCS's 271 corpora contain no Samaveda Samhita. UD_Sanskrit-Vedic's 57 texts contain no Samaveda Samhita (only Samavidhana Brahmana). VedaWeb's 7 texts contain no Samaveda. Three independent, comprehensive resources, all negative.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: SV morphology cannot be acquired. It would have to be produced, and the standing project rule against LLM-guessed Vedic attribution applies with particular force here because SV verses are largely Rigvedic borrowings, which makes a wrong answer especially plausible.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: A text-to-audio cue index exists for the Samavedic gana.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: The sAmagAnam PDFs print, per gana, the audio clip number and an mm:ss timestamp into the IISH 64-clip recording.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: FOUR_VEDA_SNAPSHOT_PROVENANCE.md finding F5, 'No timing or cue artifacts exist for any audio', is now STALE for the Samavedic gana and should be amended rather than left to be rediscovered.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Three prior conclusions in the repo's source reports are now stale.
cross_cutting_findings.detail: (1) 'No verified Samaveda Anukramani was located anywhere' - the Kauthuma Arseya Brahmana with Sayana is on Sanskrit Wikisource in 14 pages and in several public scans. (2) 'No accented machine-readable arcika text is obtainable ... the only advertised one is a dead 404' - the 404 filename (sv-kauthuma-saswara.pdf) is still 404, but samaveda_kauthuma.pdf, described on the same index page as 'Kauthuma Shakha - Saswara', is live at 1.3 MB, and a svara-bearing Kauthuma arcika also exists as 26 scanned volumes keyed by running verse number. (3) VedaWeb is no longer Rigveda-plus-AVS: it now carries seven texts including the Satapatha Brahmana with Eggeling's translation and two annotation layers.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Wave 1 should not treat the prior reports' negatives as current without checking the specific artifact named.

translation.title: The Hymns of the Samaveda, Griffith
translation.tradition_recension: RANAYANIYA arcika via Benfey - NOT Kauthuma
translation.recension_evidence: DECISIVE, and already established in SAMAVEDA_SOURCE_RESEARCH.md from Griffith's own preface, verbatim: 'I have followed Benfey's text'; and the same preface identifies Benfey's edition as of the Ranayaniya recension. Structurally, Griffith's Part II has SIX Books where the Kauthuma Uttararcika has NINE prapathakas.
translation.coverage: Complete translation of Benfey's 1,875-verse arcika. Our SV spine holds 1,844 mantras - 31 FEWER than 1,875 - so a naive running-number join drifts.
translation.coverage_verification: Item existence and page counts verified 2026-09-15: hymnsofsmaveda00grifiala (1907 printing, 398 pp), in.ernet.dli.2015.47949 (1893 first ed.), in.ernet.dli.2015.284071 / dli.ernet.16879 / in.ernet.dli.2015.68959 (1926). Verse-for-verse completeness NOT verified by opening a scan. The 1,844-vs-1,875 delta VERIFIED locally from data/canonical/samaveda_arcika_v1 (1,844 MANTRA passages; 0 translations).
translation.retrieval_method: archive.org DjVuTXT; or sacred-texts /hin/sv/ which is currently 403
translation.mapping_notes: THE CENTRAL SV TRANSLATION RISK, and three offsets compound: (1) cross-recension - Ranayaniya text against a Kauthuma spine, which ADR-010 requires to be reviewed explicitly; (2) structural - Griffith's Book/Chapter/Decade against our arcika/kanda/dasati (our top-level keys are CHANDA 585, Uttararcika 1/2/3 at 497/518/179, ARANYA 55, MAHANAMNYA 10); (3) arithmetic - 1,875 source verses against our 1,844. The only defensible join key is the RUNNING ARCIKA NUMBER, and it must be reconciled against the 31-verse delta per verse, not assumed. Getting this wrong attaches the wrong English to roughly every verse after the first discrepancy, silently.
translation.confidence: MEDIUM on availability, LOW on safe alignment without a reconciliation pass
translation.rights_note: Griffith d. 1906; 1893 and 1907 printings PD by age. No licenseurl on any item.
translation.verdict: The ONLY complete public English Samaveda found. Usable, but only behind an explicit cross-recension review and a per-verse running-number reconciliation. Do not ingest it blind.
